title: SiteEvent
description:
Contract `sites/site-event.v1`: the data of one event of `GET /v1/sites/{site}/events`.

Edge sends it as a server-sent event; the event id is the SSE `id`, not a member of this
document. The `type` is closed, and each payload refuses every member it does not declare
(workspace spec `site-live-events`). `release.published` goes to any caller with
`live.release`; `draft.changed`, `edit.completed` and `edit.conflicted` only to a `site_owner`
session of the site; `resync` to any caller, and it has no payload.

oneOf.description: A new release of the site is current; the site fetches its navigation again.
A note in the site's publications changed in the vault.
An edit of the owner reached the vault.
An edit of the owner met a revision that it did not see.
The stream lost events the client asked for; the client fetches the current state again.

NotesConflictId.title: NotesConflictId
NotesConflictId.description: Identity of one conflict of a connected vault. Bare canonical lowercase hyphenated UUID; not namespaced.

OperationId.title: OperationId
OperationId.description: Identity of one long-running operation, stable for its whole lifecycle. Bare canonical lowercase hyphenated UUID; not namespaced.

ReleaseNotice.description:
The payload of `release.published`: the release id and the publication time, and nothing else.

No page list, slug, title, source reference, vault path or draft content: an anonymous watcher
must not learn which pages changed.

published_at.description: The instant at which the release became current, from the sites service clock.

release_id.description: The new current release: the lowercase hex SHA-256 of its `sites/release.v1` document.

Slug.title: Slug
Slug.description:
The slug of one page: unique in its release, and the last part of
`/v1/sites/{site}/content/pages/{slug}`.

Segments of lower-case ASCII letters, digits and `-`, separated by `/`, at most 1024
characters. The release builder takes the frontmatter key `slug`, or else the vault path
without `.md`, lower-cased, with each run of other characters than ASCII letters, digits
and `/` replaced by one `-` (workspace spec `site-publications`).

SourceRef.title: SourceRef
SourceRef.description:
The opaque reference of one note in the publications of a site.

The sites service mints it, and only a `site_owner` session of the site ever sees it. It
names no vault path. 1 to 128 ASCII letters, digits, `_` and `-`, so it fits one path
segment of `/v1/sites/{site}/drafts/sources/{source_ref}`.

WireTimestamp.title: WireTimestamp
WireTimestamp.description: An instant on the wire: RFC 3339 in UTC with the literal `Z` designator. Exactly one spelling is accepted per instant — an input that does not re-render to itself is rejected. The field holding it declares the clock authority.
